metadata.description: Hyper3D Rigging automatically rigs existing 3D models with a skeleton for animation.

content_type.description: The mime type of the file.
content_type.title: Content Type

file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.
file_name.title: File Name

file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
file_size.title: File Size

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
url.title: Url

animation_presets.description: Up to 10 distinct stock animation IDs compatible with the skeleton. Use /rigging/animations to look up IDs, names, descriptions, and loop information. Mutually exclusive with animation_urls; leave both empty for an unanimated export.
animation_presets.title: Animation Presets

animation_urls.description: Up to 10 FBX URLs matching this rig, each nonempty, at most 25 MiB, and containing exactly one Take. Mutually exclusive with animation_presets; leave both empty for an unanimated export.
animation_urls.title: Animation Urls

bone_template.description: Skeleton template. auto selects human, quadruped, bird, dragon, or kaiju using image_url or a rendered model preview when no image is supplied. Presets forbid hierarchy and skeleton_description; custom requires exactly one.
bone_template.title: Bone Template

geometry_file_format.description: Choose one output format for the rigged mesh: GLB, FBX, or USDZ.
geometry_file_format.title: Geometry File Format

hierarchy.description: 1–256 bones defining a custom skeleton as a flat list. Requires bone_template=custom; cannot accompany skeleton_description.
hierarchy.title: Hierarchy

image_url.description: Optional JPG, PNG, or WebP reference guiding automatic template selection and skeleton_description. If omitted, auto renders a model preview and skeleton_description is processed as text only. Does not trigger texture generation.
image_url.title: Image Url

in_place.description: Export looping stock animations in place. Non-looping clips are unchanged. Cannot be enabled with animation_urls.
in_place.title: In Place

model_url.description: URL of a self-contained mesh with embedded resources: OBJ, GLB, STL, FBX, USD, USDA, USDZ, or USDC. Geometry, embedded materials, and textures are preserved without remeshing or texture generation. **Important**: Before uploading, ensure the model uses a right-handed coordinate system with +Y up and +Z forward (the direction the character faces); +X points to the character's own left. Rigging centers and uniformly scales the model, but does not automatically rotate it to face forward. Correct the orientation before exporting and uploading.
model_url.title: Model Url

skeleton_description.description: Nonblank text describing anatomy and limbs. Requires bone_template=custom and replaces hierarchy. Uses image_url when provided, otherwise text only.
skeleton_description.title: Skeleton Description

skinning_method.description: shell favors smooth weights on the visible mesh for general use; core concentrates influences around the structure for precise humanoid joints.
skinning_method.title: Skinning Method

additional_files.description: Additional model, skeleton, or animation artifacts.
additional_files.title: Additional Files

animations.description: One complete GLB per animation clip.
animations.title: Animations

fbx_file.description: Rigged FBX when the partner returns FBX.

model_mesh.description: Original rigged model, including all animation clips.

content_type.description: The mime type of the file.
content_type.title: Content Type

file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.
file_name.title: File Name

file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
file_size.title: File Size

height.description: The height of the image in pixels.
height.title: Height

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
url.title: Url

width.description: The width of the image in pixels.
width.title: Width

length.description: Bone length along local +Y in input model units. Omit for automatic calculation; explicit null is not accepted.
length.title: Length

parent.description: Parent node index, or -1 for the root.
parent.title: Parent

transform.description: Optional flat bone transform in input model coordinates.
transform.title: Transform

action_id.description: Animation clip name from the returned GLB.
action_id.title: Action Id

animation_glb.description: Complete rigged character with this clip.

info.description: The OpenAPI schema for the fal-ai/hyper3d/rigging queue.
info.title: Queue OpenAPI for fal-ai/hyper3d/rigging

x-fal-metadata.about: Rig a mesh and optionally attach compatible animation clips.

success.description: Whether the request was cancelled successfully.

schema.description: Whether to include logs (`1`) in the response or not (`0`).
